name: Pangkalpinang

queries.query: Pangkalpinang Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN geoportal
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS public map documentation. No Pangkalpinang-specific open parcel API or feature response was verified.

queries.query: Pangkalpinang peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN geoportal
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI guidance and ATLAS portal references to bidang tanah. No city-specific anonymous parcel geometry was verified.

officialSources.operator: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
officialSources.evidence: Official public map route retrieved over verified TLS; help pages describe public spatial layers including bidang tanah. The site disclaimer says official use requires an information-service request.

Official geospatial portal retrieved in discovery results; public description includes land-parcel attributes such as area, village, NIB, object name, rights status, and land use, but no Pangkalpinang feature was obtained.

officialSources.operator: Badan Informasi Geospasial / BIG Satu Peta
officialSources.evidence: Anonymous service directory returned HTTP 200 and lists provincial land-ownership sublayers, but no Kepulauan Bangka Belitung/Pangkalpinang sublayer was present in the returned directory.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official BHUMI landing HTML retrieved over verified TLS.
Official public map HTML retrieved over verified TLS and exposed current Next.js bundle references. No login or private token was used.

Current map bundle request returned 864 bytes, but it did not expose a usable anonymous parcel endpoint. Retrieval of the complete referenced bundle set timed out; this is a route limitation, not absence evidence.

Service metadata returned over verified TLS. Listed land-ownership layers include Jawa Tengah and other provinces, but not Kepulauan Bangka Belitung; no city query was possible from this service directory.
No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe owner/address query, or TLS exception was used. No parcel ID-plus-geometry response was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS national public map documentation; BIG Satu Peta public provincial land-ownership service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official public map pages and BIG service metadata were reachable, but Pangkalpinang-specific parcel features were not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point query was completed; no hit or miss is inferred. A map/API access limitation is not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: A serial reviewer should independently inspect the current BHUMI/ATLAS JavaScript and network route, determine whether a public Pangkalpinang/Bangka Belitung parcel layer exists, verify CRS and stable NIB identity, and test bounded geometry retrieval without unsafe fields.
